restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมราชวัตร
text: I appreciate the kind female staff member at the counter; she was always caring and concerned. However, one doctor lacked manners. She interrupted me before I had even finished speaking and used a rude tone. I paid for dental treatment; I wasn't asking for it for free. While I might have been wrong in some ways, she could have chosen a more respectful approach. Even though I'm younger, she should have shown more respect. P.S. The other doctors and staff were all lovely and polite.

restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมราชวัตร
text: The dentist is lovely and has a gentle touch; the scaling was painless. She's very polite. This is my second visit, and I'm so impressed with her gentle technique. I'm usually terrified of tooth pain, but I wasn't scared at all here. The dentist is very entertaining and helps patients relax. The cost is reasonable, not too expensive. I can claim 900 baht from my social security insurance, so I didn't have to pay upfront. The clinic opens at 10:00 AM, and the dentist arrives around 11:00 AM. I recommend making an appointment with the dentist beforehand.

text: Such a waste of time. If I could give 0 stars, I would. I called to make a reservation several days in advance and even called again 15 minutes before arriving to confirm. But when I got there, it was as if my booking didn't exist; they told me to wait. After waiting 30 minutes, I asked how much longer I had to wait, and they said another 30 minutes. Then they told me they had just accepted a walk-in customer. If you already have reservations, why would you accept new walk-ins? Worst service I've ever experienced.
